items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I didn't know Bunk. See, I know the Bunk but I didn't know Bunk when I seen him, you know, at all of me.

ctx.x: you see, that's why the guys, you see, because we, I don't know, we had our, we had our own style and then nobody ran their cup behind each other. Everybody had their own style they played. Bunk had his style. Bunk had a style out this world when Bunk was a young man. Bunk used to, he used to sound good out there, didn't he?
